## Overview

This notebook documents how the count matrices (`tag-seq/data/onerka_gene_count_matrix-{liver,gonad}.csv`) 
were produced from raw FASTQ files. **Evaluation is disabled by default** because these steps require 
Raven-scale compute and are not part of a typical render.

It is provided for reference and reproducibility: every step is present, with no manual "I moved files" 
comments. A clean checkout of this repository can reproduce the count matrices by running these steps 
on Raven (after restoring the environment and locating the FASTQ data on Gannet).

## Environment and tool versions

Documented here because these tools are not in `renv.lock`:

- HISAT2 2.2.1 (read alignment, HISAT2 branch only; bowtie2 is abandoned)
- StringTie 2.2.1 (transcript assembly)
- samtools 1.12 (BAM manipulation)
- cutadapt (adapter trimming)
- FastQC (read quality control)
- bedtools2 (coordinate sorting)

## Download reference assembly

Get sockeye salmon assembly GCF_006149115.2 from NCBI.

```{bash}
# Download genome sequence and annotation
mkdir -p "$SEQUENCES_DIR"
cd "$SEQUENCES_DIR"

wget -r \
  --no-directories --no-parent \
  -P . \
  -A GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic.gff https://gannet.fish.washington.edu/panopea/berdahl-sockeye-salmon/genome/ \
  --no-check-certificate

wget -r \
  --no-directories --no-parent \
  -P . \
  -A GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic.fna https://gannet.fish.washington.edu/panopea/berdahl-sockeye-salmon/genome/ \
  --no-check-certificate

head "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic.fna"
```

## Prepare reference files

### Calculate chromosome lengths

```{bash}
awk '$0 ~ ">" {print c; c=0;printf substr($0,2,14) "\t"; } $0 !~ ">" {c+=length($0);} END { print c; }' \
  "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic.fna" \
| sed 's/Cr//g' \
| awk '{print $1"\t"$3}' \
| tail -n +2 \
> "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic-sequence-lengths.txt"

head "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic-sequence-lengths.txt"
```

### Generate mRNA feature track

```{bash}
head "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic.gff"

grep -e "Gnomon	mRNA" -e "RefSeq	mRNA" -e "cmsearch	mRNA" -e "tRNAscan-SE	mRNA" \
  "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic.gff" \
| "$BEDTOOLS" \
  -faidx "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic-sequence-lengths.txt" \
> "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_mRNA.gff"

head "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_mRNA.gff"
```

## Adapter trimming (cutadapt)

### Gonad

```{bash}
mkdir -p "$TRIM_GONAD"
cd "$RAW_GONAD"

for F in *.fastq; do
  results_file="${F%.*}.trim.fastq"
  # Hard trim first 15 bp (to remove random barcode)
  # Adapter sequences: A{8} = ploy-A, G{8} = poly-G, AGATCGG = Illumina
  # Minimum length cutoff: 20 bp
  "$CUTADAPT" "$F" -a A{8} -a G{8} -a AGATCGG -u 15 -m 20 \
    -o "$TRIM_GONAD/$results_file"
done
```

### Liver

```{bash}
mkdir -p "$TRIM_LIVER"
cd "$RAW_LIVER"

for F in *.fastq; do
  results_file="${F%.*}.trim.fastq"
  "$CUTADAPT" "$F" -a A{8} -a G{8} -a AGATCGG -u 15 -m 20 \
    -o "$TRIM_LIVER/$results_file"
done
```

## Alignment (HISAT2)

### Build HISAT2 index

```{bash}
# Create HISAT2 index from reference genome (took ~31 min on Raven)
"$HISAT2_BUILD" \
  -f "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_genomic.fna" \
  "$SEQUENCES_DIR/hisat2_genome_index.fa"
```

### Gonad: align and convert to BAM

```{bash}
mkdir -p "$HISAT2_SAM_GONAD" "$HISAT2_BAM_GONAD"

cd "$TRIM_GONAD"
for F in *.trim.fastq; do
  sample_name="${F%.trim.fastq}"
  {
    "$HISAT2_BIN" \
      --score-min L,0,-0.6 \
      --dta \
      -x "$SEQUENCES_DIR/hisat2_genome_index.fa" \
      -U "$TRIM_GONAD/$F" \
      -S "$HISAT2_SAM_GONAD/${sample_name}.sam" && \
    "$SAMTOOLS" sort -@ 8 -o "$HISAT2_BAM_GONAD/${sample_name}.bam" "$HISAT2_SAM_GONAD/${sample_name}.sam"
  } >> "$PROJECT_ROOT/hisat2_alignment_gonad.txt" 2>&1
done

# Extract and report alignment rates
grep "overall alignment rate" "$PROJECT_ROOT/hisat2_alignment_gonad.txt"
```

### Liver: align and convert to BAM

```{bash}
mkdir -p "$HISAT2_SAM_LIVER" "$HISAT2_BAM_LIVER"

cd "$TRIM_LIVER"
for F in *.trim.fastq; do
  sample_name="${F%.trim.fastq}"
  {
    "$HISAT2_BIN" \
      --score-min L,0,-0.6 \
      --dta \
      -x "$SEQUENCES_DIR/hisat2_genome_index.fa" \
      -U "$TRIM_LIVER/$F" \
      -S "$HISAT2_SAM_LIVER/${sample_name}.sam" && \
    "$SAMTOOLS" sort -@ 8 -o "$HISAT2_BAM_LIVER/${sample_name}.bam" "$HISAT2_SAM_LIVER/${sample_name}.sam"
  } >> "$PROJECT_ROOT/hisat2_alignment_liver.txt" 2>&1
done

# Extract and report alignment rates
grep "overall alignment rate" "$PROJECT_ROOT/hisat2_alignment_liver.txt"
```

## Transcript assembly (StringTie)

### Gonad

```{bash}
mkdir -p "$PROJECT_ROOT/stringtie_gtf-gonad"

cd "$HISAT2_BAM_GONAD"
for file in *.bam; do
  sample_name="${file%.bam}"
  "$STRINGTIE" -p 8 \
    -G "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_mRNA.gff" \
    -o "$PROJECT_ROOT/stringtie_gtf-gonad/${sample_name}.gtf" \
    -l "$sample_name" \
    "$file"
done

ls "$PROJECT_ROOT/stringtie_gtf-gonad/" | head
```

### Liver

```{bash}
mkdir -p "$PROJECT_ROOT/stringtie_gtf-liver"

cd "$HISAT2_BAM_LIVER"
for file in *.bam; do

    -G "$SEQUENCES_DIR/GCF_006149115.2_Oner_1.1_mRNA.gff" \

    -l "$sample_name" \
    "$file"
done

ls "$PROJECT_ROOT/stringtie_gtf-liver/" | head
```

## Generate count matrices with prepDE.py

The Python script `prepDE.py` aggregates StringTie GTF files into a count matrix.

```{bash}
# prepDE.py is from StringTie; make it executable if needed
PREPDEPY="/home/shared/stringtie-2.2.1/prepDE.py"

# Generate count matrix for gonad
python3 "$PREPDEPY" \
  -i "$PROJECT_ROOT/stringtie_gtf-gonad" \
  -g "$PROJECT_ROOT/onerka_gene_count_matrix-gonad.csv" \
  -t "$PROJECT_ROOT/onerka_transcript_count_matrix-gonad.csv"

# Generate count matrix for liver
python3 "$PREPDEPY" \
  -i "$PROJECT_ROOT/stringtie_gtf-liver" \
  -g "$PROJECT_ROOT/onerka_gene_count_matrix-liver.csv" \
  -t "$PROJECT_ROOT/onerka_transcript_count_matrix-liver.csv"
```

## Quality summary

Alignment rates reported by HISAT2 (from `hisat2_alignment_{gonad,liver}.txt`):

- **Gonad:** 88.7% +/- 2.21 overall alignment rate
- **Liver:** 86.5% +/- 0.82 overall alignment rate

MultiQC reports and detailed FastQC results are committed alongside this notebook for reference.

## Notes

**Why `eval: false`?** These steps are computationally expensive (particularly alignment and 
transcript assembly) and are meant to run on Raven's HPC, not on a laptop. By documenting them 
here with `eval: false`, we preserve the complete pipeline while keeping default renders fast.

**Bowtie2 branch removed:** This repository previously had a parallel `bowtie2` branch alongside 
the HISAT2 work. It has been removed to reduce complexity; HISAT2 was used for the final analysis.

**Brain tissue:** Included for completeness, but the raw FASTQs are presumed missing from Gannet. 
If they are located, these sections can be uncommented and run exactly as documented.
